anomalies.description: A soldier in prone position fires a rifle, producing a visible dust cloud and muzzle blast at the target area.
A sudden dust and debris burst erupts from the lower portion of a cinderblock wall, consistent with an explosion or impact at that location.

A soldier is in prone position with a scoped rifle mounted on a bipod, aiming steadily through the scope across multiple frames; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the sustained aiming posture strongly indicates active engagement/shooting during this interval.
A spent bullet casing is ejected from a rifle and lands on the ground, with visible dust disturbance upon impact.

A secondary explosion or impact occurs on the ground near the previously ejected casing, producing a localized dust plume and debris displacement; likely a ricochet or nearby detonation triggered by the shot.
A bullet casing is ejected and strikes the ground, causing a visible dust impact and rebound; this is consistent with a firearm discharge captured in slow motion.

A soldier is shown aiming a rifle with a scope in a dusty environment; muzzle flash or recoil is not clearly visible, but the sustained aiming posture and context (military gear, desert setting, target building) strongly indicate active engagement/shooting.

Close-up of a soldier looking through a rifle scope, hands gripping weapon firmly, consistent with active targeting and likely firing. The focused expression and equipment confirm engagement.; A figure is seen in a window of a cinderblock building, holding what appears to be a weapon and aiming outward—consistent with return fire or defensive shooting. No muzzle flash visible, but posture and context support shooting event.
